missed_violations.scenario_name: support=0 com F1=0.80 em formato de tabela pura
missed_violations.expected_behavior: Should flag zero support metric in table row
missed_violations.actual_behavior: check_support_zero_violation regex requires 'support = 0' or 'f1:' on the data row itself and fails to correlate with header '| F1-Score |'.
missed_violations.root_cause: validate_generated_report.py lines 123-139 regex searches line-by-line for ('f1:'|'recall:') on the same line as '| 0 |', which does not exist in standard markdown tables where column names are in the header row.
missed_violations.remediation: Port table_zero_support regex from audit_executive_report.py into validate_generated_report.py.
missed_violations.resolution_notes: Implemented structural Markdown table parser (_parse_markdown_tables_support_zero) and HTML table parser (_parse_html_tables_support_zero) in validate_generated_report.py and audit_executive_report.py, handling reordered columns, escaped pipes, and point/comma decimals.

missed_violations.expected_behavior: Should detect if declared 64-char hash does not match physical artifact on disk
missed_violations.actual_behavior: Hook validate_generated_report only performs regex format checking (len == 64 and no dots); it does not compute disk SHA-256 of cited artifacts.
missed_violations.root_cause: Design limitation of lightweight regex pre-tool hook: full disk re-hashing is delegated to run_phase_gate and verify_sample_provenance.
missed_violations.remediation: Document layer separation: lightweight formatting checked in Hook; physical disk hash integrity enforced by Phase Gate and Provenance skills.
missed_violations.resolution_notes: Layered architecture ratified: Hook executes fast synchronous format checks (64 hex characters, relative workspace path); cryptographic byte-by-byte disk verification is enforced by csbot-phase-gate and csbot-dataset-forensics.

missed_violations.scenario_name: relatório com IDs demo_m01 no hook validate_generated_report
missed_violations.expected_behavior: Should flag synthetic/placeholder demo identifiers like 'demo_m01'
missed_violations.actual_behavior: Allowed write_to_file with decision='allow' and 0 violations.
missed_violations.root_cause: TEMPLATED_ID_PATTERNS only checks TEMPLATE_ID, DUMMY_SPOT, PLACEHOLDER_*, TODO_FILL, MOCK_ARTIFACT, FAKE_HASH; it does not check generic synthetic demo prefixes like 'demo_m01' or 'demo_m\d+'.
missed_violations.remediation: Add regex pattern r'\bdemo_m\d+\b' to TEMPLATED_ID_PATTERNS in validate_generated_report.py.
missed_violations.resolution_notes: Added synthetic demo regexes (demo_m\d+, synthetic_demo_\w+) to TEMPLATED_ID_PATTERNS and implemented cross-referencing against formal demo catalog datasets/mirage_v2/manifests/demo_inventory_v2.json.
